hypothesis: The project's hypothesis: a capability leaves a recurring difference between the traces of correct and wrong answers, and editing the weights where that recurring difference lives repairs the capability. This run tests nothing of it. What it has to show is narrower and is about the instrument that will judge it: that the engine's own output at each of the 105 merges, kept as the float32 bytes the recorder reads off the card at every answer step and every question position, is the same engine output the two readings of the original on record hold in their own forms (input-overlap's raw rows at the 35 attention merges; the baseline's float32 direction and log size at all 105), so that a scorer which derives its features from these raw rows reads the original and, later, a changed model by one and the same reading.
why_this_direction: Steps 1 and 2 ask for the full traces of the correct and the wrong answers, every token and every merge, and Marcos's direction of November 14 is that the gap between those traces, wherever it lies, is what is corrected and what is judged. The judge the objective's owner is building compares a model's own history with every original frame at every merge, in direction and log size (records/retrospectives/2026-11-14-whole-gap-native-rule-astra.md; SCORING.md). What a reading of a model keeps today cannot feed it: whole_reading.py keeps, at the answer steps only, export_case's float32 turn of the direction a merge and two sizes, so a state's direction there is a sum of rounded turns and the question positions are not kept at all (SCORING.md:17-21). The original's own direct features exist once, in controlled-bf16-1/baseline, as float32 direction and float32 log size, but a baseline of the original cannot read a changed model, and SCORING.md:23 requires that 'the original and candidate must be read identically on the same canonical card'. So the reader has to exist before the judge can be bound to anything, and the place to qualify it is the original, where two exact sources of the same engine outputs are on this disk. It is the next step for this seat because the target and the rule are still being written by their owners and this is the part of the judge that does not depend on which target is chosen: whatever the target, it is compared with these states.
repeating_pattern_check: Four things have happened more than once. (1) An instrument reduced what the engine put out before keeping it, and a later question needed what was dropped: the token as the marker of divergence, the count of own-answer signs (settled: no repair is read from it), the prompt's movement kept as one scalar, and the whole reading's turns, which the new scorer cannot use. This reading keeps the engine's output itself and derives nothing; a direction and a log size are what the consumer computes from it. (2) Two readings were compared that were not made the same way: the two cards word 9 of 30 answers differently, a text read 32 tokens at once is another computation, a reading made before November 14 carries no hash of the engine's libraries and is not found by its identity. This reading is token by token as the model generates, on card 0, and its manifest binds the model, the recorder, the engine's libraries, the card and the driver. (3) A check rested on shape or on a file's time instead of its content: this seat's 30 of 30 on step 1's readings came from file times and was false (Astra, afcc558b). Here every comparison is of bytes: the engine's ADD made again from its two recorded operands at every row of every merge, and the kept rows against the sources' rows, counted. (4) A capture stopped on the disk's margin mid-way (the two whole readings of November 13). The reader refuses to start unless the arrays and the raw streams in flight fit beside the 40 GiB margin, and removes each answer's raw stream once it is kept.
what_went_wrong_before: The whole reading built on November 14 (264 s a state) kept what the scorer of the day before needed and no more: turns and sizes at the answer steps. The objective's owner then moved to a whole-history comparison of direct features, and the reading could not supply it; nothing kept by any reading of this repository holds the raw state after a feed-forward's merge or a layer's last merge for the fitting answers. Before that, each of round two's readings of a candidate was made for one construction's request (the sign's row, four rows of one line, two sites) and none could be read again for another question without a new pass.
rule: Data roles: the thirty fitting answers of the cohort (tube.picks) and no others. The answers no fit uses are not read: not their tokens, not their rows in the sixty-answer source files, of which only the fitting answers' rows are opened through a memory map. The reserved folder is not opened. No answer is generated: each answer's prompt is read as every pass reads it, then its recorded tokens are supplied one at a time, and every decision's scores say whether the supplied token is the model's own first choice; a departure is recorded as it is found, with no retry and no changed feed. One recorder process on card 0 under the card's lock (after-the-others.sh), the installed recorder and engine, fusion disabled as in every pass. Before a row is kept, the engine's ADD is made again from the two operands the same pass recorded and must give the kept row bit for bit; a row that does not is an error and the reading stops. Nothing is derived, normalized or rounded in what is kept. The comparison with the sources invents no tolerance: it counts rows that are the same bits and, where some are not, states the largest difference found. Everything is written inside this run's folder. Nothing here makes a target, selects, scores, fits or writes a model, and no result about the hypothesis is read from it.
prediction: Counted by the two commands. (1) In 30 of 30 answers every supplied token is the model's own first choice on card 0, 29 end on the engine's end token and one stops at its recorded limit, as the whole reading of 8:21 to 8:26 AM CT November 14 found (records/development/2026-11-12-path-forward/README.md, 'Every matrix's rows from one pass, and a reading found by what it computed': 'A replay is a model's own answer only with its ending'). (2) The ADD made again gives the kept row at every one of the 19,751 rows of every one of the 105 merges. (3) The 35 attention merges are, bit for bit, input-overlap's stored rows at all 14,592 answer rows and all 5,159 question rows of the fitting answers (rows_reading.py's projection pass gave those bits in 140 of 140 arrays). (4) tube.unit_and_log on card 0 applied to the kept rows gives the baseline's float32 direction and log size bit for bit at every row of every merge, and the last merge's question rows give the baseline's second reading of the prompts alone.
would_weaken_it: (1) A supplied token that is not the model's choice would mean the recordings are not this card's answers under this recorder and engine; the table says which answer and step, and rows after it are a conditional replay. (2) A row the ADD does not reproduce would mean the stream's three records of a merge are not the operands and the result of one engine operation: the reader's premise is then wrong and nothing it kept is used. (3) A raw row apart from input-overlap's would mean a token-by-token replay of the recorded text is not the computation of the generation that recorded it, which every solve's rows assume. (4) If the features are not the baseline's bits the cause is looked for in the derivation first (the baseline derived all 40,865 rows of a merge in one tensor on the card, this check the 19,751 fitting rows) and then in the pass; the difference is reported as found, per merge, and the raw comparison of (3) says which of the two it is at the attention merges. Whatever is found is what the scorer's owner is told: the contract is not adjusted to fit it.
